source: ABISS final benchmark run on BIRD dev, 11 Nov 2026

question.nlq: Could you tell me for each constructor, in each season they participated, their total points, the points difference from the previous season, the percentage point change, and the best (lowest) race position achieved by any of their drivers in that season?

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH constructor_season AS (
    SELECT
        r."constructorId",
        s."year",
        SUM(r."points") AS total_points,
        MIN(r."position") AS best_position
    FROM "results" r
    JOIN "races" ra ON r."raceId" = ra."raceId"
    JOIN "seasons" s ON ra."year" = s."year"
    GROUP BY r."constructorId", s."year"
)
SELECT
    c."name" AS constructor,
    cs."year" AS season,
    cs.total_points,
    cs.total_points - LAG(cs.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY cs."constructorId" ORDER BY cs."year") AS points_diff,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(cs.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY cs."constructorId" ORDER BY cs."year") IS NOT NULL
             AND LAG(cs.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY cs."constructorId" ORDER BY cs."year") <> 0
        THEN ((cs.total_points - LAG(cs.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY cs."constructorId" ORDER BY cs."year")) * 100.0 /
              LAG(cs.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY cs."constructorId" ORDER BY cs."year"))
        ELSE NULL
    END AS pct_point_change,
    cs.best_position
FROM constructor_season cs
JOIN "constructors" c ON cs."constructorId" = c."constructorId"
ORDER BY c."name", cs."year";

WITH season_stats AS (
  SELECT
    c.constructorId,
    c.name AS constructorName,
    r.year,
    SUM(res.points) AS total_points,
    MIN(res.position) AS best_position
  FROM constructors c
  JOIN results res ON c.constructorId = res.constructorId
  JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, r.year
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT
    constructorId,
    constructorName,
    year,
    total_points,
    best_position,
    LAG(total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY constructorId ORDER BY year) AS prev_points
  FROM season_stats
)
SELECT
  constructorId,
  constructorName,
  year,
  total_points,
  CASE WHEN prev_points IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE total_points - prev_points END AS points_difference,
  CASE WHEN prev_points IS NULL OR prev_points = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(((total_points - prev_points) * 100.0) / prev_points, 2) END AS percentage_point_change,
  best_position
FROM with_lag
ORDER BY constructorId, year;

WITH saison_points AS (
  SELECT
    c.constructorId,
    c.name AS constructorName,
    r.year AS season,
    SUM(res.points) AS total_points,
    MIN(res.position) AS best_position
  FROM constructors c
  JOIN results res ON c.constructorId = res.constructorId
  JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, r.year
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    constructorId,
    constructorName,
    season,
    total_points,
    best_position,
    LAG(total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY constructorId ORDER BY season) AS prev_points
  FROM saison_points
)
SELECT
  constructorName,
  season,
  total_points,
  (total_points - prev_points) AS points_difference,
  CASE WHEN prev_points IS NULL OR prev_points = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(((total_points - prev_points) * 100.0) / prev_points, 2) END AS percentage_point_change,
  best_position
FROM lagged
ORDER BY constructorName, season;

WITH season_points AS (
  SELECT c.constructorId, c.name AS constructorName, r.year,
         SUM(cr.points) AS total_points
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, r.year
),
best_position AS (
  SELECT c.constructorId, r.year,
         MIN(res.position) AS best_position
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorId = c.constructorId
  WHERE res.position IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, r.year
)
SELECT sp.constructorName,
       sp.year,
       sp.total_points,
       (sp.total_points - LAG(sp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.constructorId ORDER BY sp.year)) AS points_difference,
       CASE
         WHEN LAG(sp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.constructorId ORDER BY sp.year) IS NULL
              OR LAG(sp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.constructorId ORDER BY sp.year) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE ROUND(((sp.total_points - LAG(sp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.constructorId ORDER BY sp.year)) * 100.0)
                    / LAG(sp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.constructorId ORDER BY sp.year), 2)
       END AS percent_point_change,
       bp.best_position
FROM season_points sp
JOIN best_position bp ON sp.constructorId = bp.constructorId AND sp.year = bp.year
ORDER BY sp.constructorId, sp.year;

WITH season_points AS (

        r.year,
        cs.constructorId,
        SUM(cs.points) AS total_points
    FROM constructorStandings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructorId
),
season_best_pos AS (

        r.year,
        res.constructorId,
        MIN(res.position) AS best_position
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE res.position IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructorId

SELECT
    c.constructorRef,
    sp.year,
    sp.total_points,
    LAG(sp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.constructorId ORDER BY sp.year) AS prev_total_points,
    sp.total_points - LAG(sp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.constructorId ORDER BY sp.year) AS points_diff,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(sp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.constructorId ORDER BY sp.year) IS NULL
             OR LAG(sp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.constructorId ORDER BY sp.year) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (sp.total_points - LAG(sp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.constructorId ORDER BY sp.year)) * 100.0
             / LAG(sp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY sp.constructorId ORDER BY sp.year)
    END AS pct_point_change,
    sbp.best_position
FROM season_points sp
JOIN constructors c ON sp.constructorId = c.constructorId
LEFT JOIN season_best_pos sbp ON sp.year = sbp.year AND sp.constructorId = sbp.constructorId
ORDER BY c.constructorRef, sp.year;

WITH constructor_season_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year AS season,
        cs.constructorId,
        SUM(cs.points) AS total_points
    FROM constructorStandings cs
    INNER JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructorId
),
yearly_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        cst.season,
        cst.constructorId,
        cst.total_points,
        LAG(cst.total_points, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cst.constructorId ORDER BY cst.season) AS prev_year_points,
        cst.total_points - COALESCE(LAG(cst.total_points, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cst.constructorId ORDER BY cst.season), 0) AS points_diff,
        CASE 
            WHEN LAG(cst.total_points, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cst.constructorId ORDER BY cst.season) IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN LAG(cst.total_points, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cst.constructorId ORDER BY cst.season) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (cst.total_points - LAG(cst.total_points, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cst.constructorId ORDER BY cst.season)) * 100.0 / CAST(LAG(cst.total_points, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cst.constructorId ORDER BY cst.season) AS REAL)
        END AS pct_change
    FROM constructor_season_totals cst
),
driver_best_positions AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year AS season,
        res.constructorId,
        MIN(res.position) AS best_position
    FROM results res
    INNER JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE res.position > 0
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructorId
)
SELECT 
    c.name AS constructor_name,
    yc.season,
    yc.total_points,
    yc.points_diff,
    ROUND(yc.pct_change, 2) AS percentage_point_change,
    dbp.best_position
FROM yearly_changes yc
INNER JOIN constructors c ON yc.constructorId = c.constructorId
LEFT JOIN driver_best_positions dbp ON yc.season = dbp.season AND yc.constructorId = dbp.constructorId
ORDER BY c.name, yc.season;

constructor_with_prev AS (

        csp.constructor_name,
        csp.year,
        csp.total_points,
        LAG(csp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY csp.constructorRef ORDER BY csp.year) AS prev_season_points,
        csp.total_points - COALESCE(LAG(csp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY csp.constructorRef ORDER BY csp.year), 0) AS points_diff,
        CASE 
            WHEN LAG(csp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY csp.constructorRef ORDER BY csp.year) IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN LAG(csp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY csp.constructorRef ORDER BY csp.year) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((csp.total_points - LAG(csp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY csp.constructorRef ORDER BY csp.year)) * 100.0 / LAG(csp.total_points) OVER (PARTITION BY csp.constructorRef ORDER BY csp.year))
        END AS pct_change
    FROM constructor_season_points csp
),
driver_best_position AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        res.constructorId,
        MIN(res.position) AS best_driver_position
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE res.position IS NOT NULL

)
SELECT 
    cwpp.constructorRef,
    cwpp.constructor_name,
    cwpp.year,

    cwpp.points_diff,

WITH constructor_season_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        c.constructorId,
        c.name as constructor_name,
        SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructorStandings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
    GROUP BY r.year, c.constructorId, c.name
),
constructor_best_positions AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        res.constructorId,
        MIN(res.position) as best_position
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE res.position IS NOT NULL AND res.position > 0
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructorId
)
cs
SELECT 
    cst.constructor_name,
    cst.year,
    cst.total_points,
    cst.total_points - COALESCE(
        (SELECT SUM(cs_prev.points)
         FROM constructorStandings cs_prev
         JOIN races r_prev ON cs_prev.raceId = r_prev.raceId
         WHERE r_prev.year = cst.year - 1
           AND cs_prev.constructorId = cst.constructorId),
        0
    ) as points_difference_from_previous,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(
            (SELECT SUM(cs_prev.points)
             FROM constructorStandings cs_prev
             JOIN races r_prev ON cs_prev.raceId = r_prev.raceId
             WHERE r_prev.year = cst.year - 1
               AND cs_prev.constructorId = cst.constructorId),
            0
        ) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(
            ((cst.total_points - 
              (SELECT SUM(cs_prev.points)
               FROM constructorStandings cs_prev
               JOIN races r_prev ON cs_prev.raceId = r_prev.raceId
               WHERE r_prev.year = cst.year - 1
                 AND cs_prev.constructorId = cst.constructorId)) *
            100.0 / 
            (SELECT SUM(cs_prev.points)
             FROM constructorStandings cs_prev
             JOIN races r_prev ON cs_prev.raceId = r_prev.raceId
             WHERE r_prev.year = cst.year - 1
               AND cs_prev.constructorId = cst.constructorId)), 2
        )
        ELSE NULL
    END as percentage_point_change,
    COALESCE(cbp.best_position, 'N/A') as best_race_position
FROM constructor_season_totals cst
LEFT JOIN constructor_best_positions cbp ON cst.year = cbp.year AND cst.constructorId = cbp.constructorId
ORDER BY cst.constructor_name, cst.year;

question.nlq: Could you tell me which drivers have won more than 5 races in a single season, along with their full name, the season year, and the number of wins they achieved?

meanings.gt_sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driverName, r.year AS seasonYear, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM "results" res JOIN "races" r ON res.raceId = r.raceId JOIN "drivers" d ON res.driverId = d.driverId WHERE res.position = 1 GROUP BY d.driverId, r.year HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS fullname, r.year AS season, COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE res.position = 1
GROUP BY d.driverId, r.year
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY season DESC, wins DESC;

question.nlq: Hey there! I'm super curious about the racing history - could you help me figure out which British drivers have finished in the top 3 positions at any circuit in Malaysia? I'd love to know their full names and exactly how many times they've podiumed there!

meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT 
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS name,
    COUNT(*) AS podium_count
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON ra.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE c.country = 'Malaysia'
    AND d.nationality = 'British'
    AND r.position <= 3
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY podium_count DESC
